seed_audit.numeric_csv_false_positive_note: Values in 40000–40255 found in SPG shape-statistics non-seed columns; the seed column is 245xx and has no intersection.

metrics.MaxF: mean over structures of max_i norm(F_i); raw pre-relax structure
metrics.Atomic Force: mean over structures of within-structure mean_i norm(F_i); NOT atom-count pooled
metrics.E-hull: MatterSim-relaxed surrogate energy relative to frozen Alex-MP reference, eV/atom
metrics.NUS: novel AND unique AND stable, labels computed in each fixed cohort
metrics.Property MAE: CHGNet sum(abs atomic magmom)/volume error relative to conditioned target; surrogate only
metrics.Validity: geometric structure validity; not composition validity or synthesizability

statistics.original: Unmodified archived decisions and CIs in original_decisions.json; original I1 bootstrap RNG/count unavailable in supplied archive.

supplementary_finalization.method: paired seed bootstrap percentile 95%; ratio of resampled means, not mean per-seed percent; no multiple testing adjustment; all seeds retained

statistics.uniqueness_warning: Bootstrap conditions on full-cohort unique/novel labels, does not rerun deduplication on resampled structures.
statistics.wins_warning: E3 original primary uses strict signs; its harm epsilon is 1e-6; supplementary table uses 1e-12. Do not conflate these.
